item.title: Utah forces Chinese company to sell motorsports park in Tooele County
item.description: A Chinese company has been forced to sell a Tooele County motorsports park, Utah leaders announced Thursday. It's the first forced divestiture under a state law meant to block Chinese ownership of Utah real estate.

item.title: Rocky Mountain Power shelters in place as police apprehend man barricaded in bathroom
item.description: A shelter-in-place order was issued at the Rocky Mountain Power headquarters building on Thursday afternoon, as police attempted to apprehend a man who barricaded himself in a restroom.

item.title: Jazz Fined $500,000 For Resting Markkanen, Jackson Jr.
item.description: The NBA announced a $500,000 fine for the Utah Jazz for resting Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. in recent games.

item.title: Unplugged for 48 Hours: Inside the Viral “Analog Bag Challenge”
item.description: Could a bag of simple old-school hobbies be the cure for digital overload? The viral “Analog Bag Challenge” dares people to unplug for 48 hours and discover life offline. KSL News took on the challenge and spoke with an expert about how endless social media scrolling affects our brains.

item.title: Jazz Fined $500,000 For Resting Markkanen, Jackson Jr.
item.description: The NBA fined the Utah Jazz $500,000 for resting Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. in the fourth quarter of two recent games, the league announced Wednesday.

item.title: Mysterious, historic Logan Canyon property has new owner
item.description: A mysterious property in Logan Canyon with ties to old Hollywood has a new owner and a new vision for the future.

item.title: Ryan Smith Tells Bobby Marks “Sit This One Out” After Fine
item.description: Utah Jazz owner Ryan Smith had strong words for ESPN analyst and former Brooklyn Nets executive Bobby Marks on Thursday.

item.title: Irregular heartbeat? Experts say early care can prevent serious complications
item.description: An irregular heartbeat could signal a heart rhythm disorder, also known as an arrythmia.

item.title: ‘Never seen anything like it’: Thousands of Utahns want their names removed from Prop 4 repeal
item.description: With just days left to collect signatures in the effort to repeal Proposition 4, county clerks have received more than 2,300 requests from people asking for their signatures to be removed.

item.title: Utah Jazz Enter All-Star Break After Bizarre 24 Hours
item.description: The most exciting week in years for the Utah Jazz ended on a sour note after a hefty fine levied by the NBA.
